newsitem.title: CHINA: China executes HK men for drug charges-agency.
newsitem.headline: China executes HK men for drug charges-agency.

text.p: China executed five Hong Kong men for drug trafficking on Friday, the semi-official China News Agency reported.
Shenzhen Intermediate People's Court convicted them of selling drugs in southern China's boomtown of Shenzhen, the agency said.
One of the convicts was 41-year-old Ji Xiaowei, for whom London-based human rights group Amnesty International issued an appeal on Thursday.
In a statement, the group said Ji claimed his conviction was based on a confession extracted under torture and on the statements of his two co-defendants. It appealed to stop Ji's execution.
Another mainland Chinese was also executed on drug charges, the report said.
Chinese officials were not available to comment.
